purpose: Promotion of a model or package is evidence-based only. Missing evidence = BLOCKED (never assume).

requiredEvidence.description: Live host matches expected product host / host profile
Host package identity matches intended publish package
Active primary model matches expected product model
Dated live product-host suite PASS at threshold (not offline rescore)
No corpus-fallback / ollama-degraded / interim llama3.2 / ForceCorpusFallback
Clobber protection OK; no unauthorized product-tag clobber evidence
Rollback procedure + precutover baseline + cutover prev-rename present
Manifest evalStatus/score agree with cited live report; no PASS claim without live evidence
Evidence ledger present, cites current live authority report, append-only writer intact

forbiddenAssumptions: Offline alias rescore is not live suite PASS
Local/package-only checks are not host authority
Missing packageIdentity is not assumed current
Missing runtime-truth is not assumed healthy
Manifest PASS without matching dated live report is not promotion-green

emergencyBypass.note: Emergency only. Still records BLOCKED reasons; does not rewrite ledger or claim PASS.
